verdict: No concrete planner, allocation-order, scalar/clip semantics or fixture/test expectation defect found within the bounded read-only review.
execution: No candidate Rust, compiler, Cargo, engine, Canvas, GPU or test execution by reviewer. Only source/AST/data extraction, hashes and independent mathematical comparison.

reviewed_semantics.conclusion: Image coverage intersects using f32 Rect arithmetic, applies floor(image-visible-origin), ceil(lower clip), frame zero lower bound, and ceil(reconstructed visible end) limited by BOTH ceil clip upper edges and frame size. This matches the CPU image loop plus blend half-open integer-origin containment. Rectangle-only coverage retains its earlier formula.

Exact original translated origin/extent retained in ImageDraft. The expression performs f32 integer conversion, subtraction, division, multiplication, clamp and truncation in the CPU order. No center shift, reciprocal multiplication, f64 widening, FMA or finite-intermediate rejection. A tiny positive extent may yield +/-infinity, then clamp. Positive extents cannot yield 0/0.

reviewed_semantics.conclusion: Frame/command authored geometry and offsets are finite and capped. Translated values remain finite under those caps. Normalized viewport clip matches Canvas set_clip. PushFixed resets caller clip and viewport offset; PopFixed restores both. Image source IDs and geometry are checked before hidden/empty coverage suppression.

Private immutable metadata preserves original first 32 rectangle bytes and zero padding; image records add source base/width/height/pixels and x/y bases/counts at words 8..15. Every slot remains 256 bytes, little-endian. Arena/source offsets refer to owned packed bytes.

resource_and_ownership_review.conclusion: Source count <=256 precedes metadata iteration. Nonzero dimensions, checked u64 product*4, exact actual length and aggregate <=1MiB are completed for all sources before alpha scans. Alpha is checked once per supplied source, including unused sources; repeated draw references do not repeat source-area validation.

Frame <=320x240 and input commands <=256 precede planner reserves. Scope capacity 32 is reserved before pushes and checked before each push. Pending capacity commands+1 is enough because each command emits at most one draw plus the clear. Each visible draw updates checked rounded8x8 invocations <=4M and each image updates checked LUT count <=143360 before insertion.

Checked all-source words plus LUT words and 256-byte metadata slots are summed with output+readback eight bytes/pixel. The <=1MiB GPU byte gate occurs before source packing, table creation, final draw storage and parameter allocation. No-image plans use zero input arena, while their declared source validation still runs.

Fallible exact reserve covers the entire input byte count. Each supplied source is packed once; each visible image appends exactly its width+height pre-counted words. The final arena length is checked. Draws reserve pending count; parameters reserve checked exact size before resize. Bounds keep all u32/i32/usize offset conversions safe on supported 32/64-bit hosts.

Plan, Draw and ImageParameters fields are private, constructors are private and accessors return copies or immutable slices. Source inputs are borrowed only while planning, then copied into owned bytes; caller mutations cannot change the returned plan. has_images iff nonempty input is consistent because a visible image requires a nonzero source and nonempty x/y tables.
The wrapper rejects >MAX_SOURCE_ENTRIES before reserving borrowed views and uses try_reserve_exact. Its fixture inputs and independent expected arrays remain bounded constants.

Negative/hidden tests retain dimensions, lengths, alpha, invalid-ID, geometry, scope and budget conditions; no expected rejection was removed or converted into success.

test_review.exact_boundaries: 1,048,576 GPU bytes accept; +one source pixel rejects as GPU buffer budget. 4,000,000 invocations accept; +one 1x1 rounded dispatch rejects as GPU invocation budget. Source-count 256, command-count 256 and depth 32 acceptance remain.
test_review.shared_helper_inputs: Some private malformed-source metadata checks omit a drawable command to verify rejection even for unused inputs; source-count acceptance shares a different clear color which is completely overwritten. These do not alter the frozen condition, expected result, 14 exact pixel inputs or any protocol tuple.
test_review.independence: The private metadata interpreter reads planned bytes only as the actual side; expected pixels remain independent literal rows/direct integer bands. Tests of plan ownership mutate an original unused source after planning and assert retained arena bytes; reused source IDs point at the same packed base.

limitations: This is a static planner/test review, not observed CPU/GPU correctness or a proof over arbitrary float inputs. The frozen mathematical oracle supplies independent edge expectations.
WGSL shader/device integration and native runtime cleanup are separate review scopes; this receipt does not assert they executed or passed.

Explicit GPU bytes exclude CPU input/expected arrays, concurrent bounded planning structures, staging and driver allocations; fallible planner reserves do not claim general process-wide allocator recovery.
